name: SpeechParaling-Bench-English
description: A collection of English-language paralinguistic tasks measuring non-linguistic speech attributes (e.g., emotion, speaker traits) from audio recordings. It is designed to evaluate models' ability to detect and classify paralinguistic signals rather than transcribed content. Benchmarks typically include classification and regression-style labels for various speaker and utterance-level properties.
evaluation_method: F1 (often macro F1) and accuracy for classification; RMSE or MAE for regression tasks
reputation: A niche academic dataset used in paralinguistics research with modest adoption for speech-attribute benchmarking.
